philosophy.title: Stop Renting Intelligence. Own Your Intelligence.
philosophy.description: Swarm Agentic Lab is not sold as a fixed SaaS subscription. Every deployment is designed around the customer's operational goals, infrastructure, security requirements, and agent adoption roadmap. We help organizations replace repetitive SaaS workflows with agent-powered systems while maintaining full ownership of their data, intelligence, and infrastructure.

design_principles: Cloud-agnostic — works on AWS, GCP, Azure, or on-premise
LLM-agnostic — bring your own OpenAI, Mistral, Anthropic, or open-source model
Framework-agnostic — integrates with your existing stack without ripping it out

communication_platforms.description: Swarm agents can send notifications, alerts, and human-in-the-loop approval requests through communication platforms.

developer_platforms.description: Swarm integrates with developer toolchains for trigger-based automation and CI/CD workflows.

api_protocols.description: Swarm agents connect to external systems through standard API protocols.

supported_triggers: Webhook (inbound HTTP events from any external system)
Database Event (PostgreSQL WAL, MongoDB Change Stream)
API call from your own backend
